tagline: A keep-going loop for agents that never collapses.
why: Agents die on long runs: context bloat, silent quality drift, runaway spend. This harness keeps them working indefinitely.
what: A stdlib loop server + installable plugin (pi/opencode): heartbeat, verify gates, checkpoints, compaction, budget ledger, stop conditions.
how: Stdlib Python server + single-file UI + append-only logs. Each tick: heartbeat -> verify -> compact -> ship one micro-goal. Plugin reuses the same policy via any harness.
goal: Demonstrate 10 clean ticks with quality above floor and spend under budget.
real_spend_tracking_doc: Flip to true only when tick ledger costs reconcile against a real billing API or invoice (metered credits/Stripe); while false every ledger $ is a simulated estimate — no real spend connected.
hands_enabled_doc: Loop hands master switch. true = every tick ends its e083 observation in an artifact/action (gap row / growth draft / honest skip). false = observe-only (old behavior).
hands_e083_url_doc: Override collector base URL. Empty = auto from ../e083-scrapenet/needs.json port on 127.0.0.1 (same machine). Set only for a remote collector.
hands_rules_doc: Per-tick hands, decided here (never hardcoded): publishes stalled vs last tick -> POST /api/gaps {source e082-loop} (priority high when the e083 funnel verdict is FAILING, which also escalates on its own); records grew -> POST /api/growth/draft ONE post (source:loop, unapproved — human/auto-approve rules there decide, never auto-posted); e083 unreachable -> log honestly to log/hands.log and skip (no artifact claimed). Dedupe: one open gap per stall level, one pending loop draft — the 60s daemon must not spam.
limits_doc: LIMITS.md is the second backlog source: every Nth tick the loop consumes one OPEN [limits-lN] checkbox (smallest shippable slice = read-only local probe, evidence in evidence.jsonl). Checked boxes are done and skipped. No accounts created, no logins bypassed, no posts made, no payments issued.
